CustomField.description: Leads converted to customers during a partner's temporary access (between its start and end dates) that let the partner keep logging in after the access ends. Either this or Exclusive Site Visits is enough. Blank or 0: conversions do not count.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Converted leads during the temporary access that keep the partner's login after it ends (either this or Exclusive Site Visits). Blank or 0: not counted.
CustomField.label: Exclusive Converted Leads
